evals.prompt: Orca updated overnight and our dispatch docs feel off — re-pin the runtime contract against the installed binary.
evals.expected_output: Should route to pin-it. Should freeze a claim inventory from runtime policies/scripts/mission preambles, load version-matched guides via orca skills get, re-witness each claim against the live runtime with receipts, patch stale claims citing receipts, and terminate PINNED or PINNED-WITH-PARKED.
assertions: Freezes a per-claim inventory as the denominator
Loads version-matched guides from the installed binary (orca skills get)
Classifies claims only from live receipts, never from reading docs
Removed claims carry an archived refutation receipt

evals.prompt: Upgrade the repo from React 18 to React 19 and fix the breakages.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to pin-it. A dependency/framework upgrade with the repo's own build+test suite as oracle is modernize-it. pin-it's unit is a runtime-mechanics claim and its oracle is receipts from the live control-plane binary.
assertions: Distinguishes a doctrine claim about runtime mechanics from a dependency upgrade

evals.prompt: The README claims a command that no longer exists — sweep all the stale doc claims.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to pin-it. A falsifiable prose-claims backlog against repo state is clean-sweep source=doc-claims. pin-it re-witnesses runtime-mechanics claims against the live Orca binary.
assertions: Distinguishes prose doc-claims about the repo from mechanics claims about the runtime binary
